eyebrow: Exact deduplication: cheap, but misses near-duplicates
code:
import hashlib

seen_hashes = set()

def is_exact_duplicate(text: str) -> bool:
    normalized = " ".join(text.split()).lower()
    h = hashlib.sha256(normalized.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    if h in seen_hashes:
        return True
    seen_hashes.add(h)
    return False
caption: Catches byte-for-byte duplicates, but not a reformatted or lightly-edited copy.
LSH buckets documents so only likely-similar pairs are ever compared -- avoiding O(n^2).
